exposure: Antithyroid drug (ATD) use before and/or during pregnancy
cohort: All singleton births in Finland between 2004 and 2013 (N = 571,785)
finding: Maternal hyperthyroidism, particularly when treated with ATDs (indicating active disease), was associated with increased odds of pregnancy and perinatal complications.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was more common among mothers with hyperthyroidism.
